note: Bars are numeric and committed before a run. These bars are PROPOSED by the Jev foundation lane and are not yet ratified by Kane, so a run against them is not a ratified gate. The harness refuses to score a point that has no bar here, which is the point of the file. Editing a bar changes manifestDigest, and loadManifest refuses a manifest whose recorded digest does not match its contents, so a bar cannot be moved after the fact and still read as committed.

splitPolicy.note: Held out by whole model and by ask family, never by row. These three models are reserved for the held-out gate and have not been run. Pilot one used aw_packt and contoso, which are therefore development evidence and can never be the gate.
